nodes.name: Governance Kernel (Devere TCS Governed-Work Core)
nodes.summary: The contract layer. The plugin manifest plus the README catalog that declares all 32 Work Instructions, their IDs, and their ownership. Every downstream skill exists because the kernel named it. Source authority for the construction route map.

nodes.name: Construction PM
nodes.summary: Project Manager surface. Owns scope, schedule logic, RFI processing, and cross-trade coordination on the CSI-division trade skills. Pulls controls from the kernel, dispatches WIs to trades, and consumes ops-agent receipts.

nodes.name: Construction Super
nodes.summary: Field Superintendent surface. Owns daily-of-record execution: morning huddle, daily log, field monitoring, housekeeping, photo doc. Where the PM's plan meets the dirt.

nodes.name: Construction Safety
nodes.summary: Safety surface. Owns the gates that must close before trade work can fire: huddle, PPE/equipment, post-rain SWPPP. Hard prerequisite enforcement.

nodes.name: Construction Quality
nodes.summary: Quality Control surface. Hold-point inspections, QC audits, AHJ inspections, compliance audits and notices. The control loop that pairs with each trade skill.

nodes.name: Construction Cost
nodes.summary: Cost surface. Material receiving, Go Codes equipment scans, and RFI processing connect spend and logistics to the schedule and the closeout package.

nodes.name: Construction Estimating
nodes.summary: Estimating surface. Reads the CSI-division trade skills (d03, d05, d22, d23, d26) to scope and price work; consumes RFI outputs to true up estimates against field reality.

nodes.name: Construction Scheduling
nodes.summary: Scheduling surface. The 3-Week Look Ahead is the forward-looking control; the Daily Log is the backward-looking record; Field Monitoring keeps the variance honest.

nodes.name: Construction Closeout
nodes.summary: Closeout surface. Punchlist Closeout drives defects to zero; As-Built Updates capture field deviations into the record set so the owner inherits a true archive.

nodes.name: Operational Agents (ops-agents)
nodes.summary: The operational-agents tier referenced by the construction-ops-agents skill family: live-action gate, source-query receipt, contract authority. These agents sit alongside the construction domains and enforce or record the governed controls in real time.

flows.name: Kernel declares the 32 WI catalog

steps.control: plugin manifest binds README as the WI catalog
every WI ID in the catalog must resolve to a SKILL.md (32-of-32)
contract authority for the route map — ops-agents verify each WI exists and is owned

flows.narrative: The plugin manifest registers tcs-construction. README declares the 32 WI IDs. construction-contract-authority verifies every declared ID resolves to a SKILL.md. PM and Estimating consume the catalog as their unit-of-work index.

flows.name: PM dispatches a CSI-division trade skill

steps.control: kernel routes the WI to PM
Morning Huddle + SE Check must close before trade work fires
Hold Point Inspection gates trade work at the rebar-before-pour milestone
construction-live-action-gate records that the trade WI fired with a passing precondition stack

flows.narrative: PM picks the d03 Concrete Slab Rebar Install WI. Safety domain validates huddle + PPE. Quality domain runs Hold Point Inspection. The live-action-gate ops-agent stamps the receipt. Super takes execution; Cost records material against the PO.

flows.name: Super daily heartbeat (Huddle -> Log -> Photo)

steps.control: huddle plan informs the day's field monitoring focus
field observations populate the Daily Log
Daily Log entries are backed by Photo Documentation
construction-source-query-receipt verifies Silence-is-Failure rule

flows.narrative: Super runs the morning huddle, walks the site under Field Monitoring, writes the Daily Log, attaches Photo Doc evidence. source-query-receipt ops-agent enforces the Silence-is-Failure principle. PM ingests the log; Scheduling reconciles against the 3WLA.

flows.name: Safety gate stack before trade work

steps.control: huddle topic informs SE check focus
post-rain only fires after a weather event
trade-skill dispatch is blocked until the gate stack closes
construction-live-action-gate records pass/fail by photo + signature

flows.narrative: Morning Huddle, Safety Equipment Check, and (if weather demanded) Post-Rain SWPPP run as a precondition stack. construction-live-action-gate ops-agent stamps the close. Only then does PM dispatch a trade WI.

flows.name: Quality hold-point gate inside a trade WI

steps.control: rebar-before-pour hold point pauses the trade WI
QC Audit invoked when hold-point findings exceed threshold
Comply Notice issued when audit fails
construction-contract-authority binds the hold-point pass back to the kernel contract

flows.narrative: Hold Point Inspection pauses the trade WI. If findings stack up, QC Audit walks spec compliance and Comply Notice issues. construction-contract-authority ops-agent records the audit chain against the WI contract. PM is unblocked when the hold point closes.

flows.name: Cost: Material Receiving feeds the 3-Way Match gate

steps.control: Go Codes scan tracks equipment alongside material delivery
Photo Doc records the receiving event
construction-source-query-receipt logs the PO-to-physical match for the 3-Way Match gate

flows.narrative: Material Receiving runs at the gate; Go Codes scans tag equipment; Photo Doc supplies evidence; source-query-receipt ops-agent records the PO-to-physical match for the downstream 3-Way Match gate. PM updates cost. Closeout inherits the asset record.

flows.name: Estimating builds budget from the trade-skill catalog

steps.control: kernel exposes the d05 Structural Steel WI as a unit-of-work
RFI outputs may change scope after award
PM consumes RFI-driven estimate updates
construction-contract-authority binds the priced WI to the budget baseline

flows.narrative: Estimating reads the CSI-division WIs as its unit-of-work catalog and prices each. RFI Processing flags scope changes. construction-contract-authority ops-agent stamps the budget baseline. PM and Cost inherit the budget.

flows.name: Scheduling: 3WLA forward vs Daily Log backward

steps.control: Daily Log compared against 3WLA each cycle
Field Monitoring observations refine the next 3WLA
construction-live-action-gate stamps schedule variance for the PM dashboard

flows.narrative: The 3WLA is the forward control; the Daily Log is the backward record; Field Monitoring keeps the variance honest. construction-live-action-gate ops-agent records variance for PM. PM replans into the next 3WLA cycle.

flows.name: Closeout: Punchlist drives to zero then As-Built freezes the record

steps.control: Punchlist must reach zero before as-builts freeze
as-built handoff closes the kernel contract
construction-source-query-receipt and construction-contract-authority sign the turnover package

flows.narrative: Punchlist Closeout drives defects to zero. As-Built Updates fold every field deviation back into the drawings. source-query-receipt + contract-authority ops-agents sign the turnover. The kernel contract closes.

flows.name: Ops-agents cross-cut every domain

steps.control: live-action-gate records WI dispatch events
contract-authority binds hold-point and audit results to the kernel
source-query-receipt enforces Silence-is-Failure on the Daily Log
ops-agents sign the turnover package

flows.narrative: The three ops-agents (live-action-gate, source-query-receipt, contract-authority) cross-cut every skill domain. They record dispatch, audit chains, daily-log compliance, and turnover signatures back into the kernel.

domains.name: Governance Kernel (Devere TCS Governed-Work Core)
domains.summary: The contract layer. The plugin manifest plus the README catalog that declares all 32 Work Instructions, their IDs, and their ownership. Every downstream skill exists because the kernel named it. Source authority for the construction route map.
responsibilities: Declare the 32 Work Instruction IDs (the WI catalog)
Register the plugin with Claude Code (SSU Fleet, v1.0.0)
Hold the governed-work contracts that bind the trade, control, and ops-agent layers
Define source authority for every control that fires on a project

domains.name: Construction PM
domains.summary: Project Manager surface. Owns scope, schedule logic, RFI processing, and cross-trade coordination on the CSI-division trade skills. Pulls controls from the kernel, dispatches WIs to trades, and consumes ops-agent receipts.
responsibilities: Coordinate CSI-division trade skills (d03, d05, d22, d23, d26)
Drive RFI processing and design-question resolution
Own 3-Week Look Ahead handoff to the Super
Consume Daily Log + Field Monitoring outputs to update project state

domains.name: Construction Super
domains.summary: Field Superintendent surface. Owns daily-of-record execution: morning huddle, daily log, field monitoring, housekeeping, photo doc. Where the PM's plan meets the dirt.
responsibilities: Run Morning Huddle / Toolbox Talk to start the day
Write the Daily Log (Silence is Failure)
Monitor field production and call out blockers
Drive housekeeping and site condition standards

domains.name: Construction Safety
domains.summary: Safety surface. Owns the gates that must close before trade work can fire: huddle, PPE/equipment, post-rain SWPPP. Hard prerequisite enforcement.
responsibilities: Enforce Morning Huddle as a precondition to trade work
Verify Safety Equipment (PPE, fall protection, etc.)
Run Post-Rain SWPPP environmental inspection
Block downstream skills when safety prerequisites fail

domains.name: Construction Quality
domains.summary: Quality Control surface. Hold-point inspections, QC audits, AHJ inspections, compliance audits and notices. The control loop that pairs with each trade skill.
responsibilities: Enforce Hold Points before trade work proceeds (e.g., rebar before pour)
Run QC Audits against spec compliance
Coordinate Regulator / AHJ inspections
Run Compliance Audits and issue Comply Notices

domains.name: Construction Cost
domains.summary: Cost surface. Material receiving, Go Codes equipment scans, and RFI processing connect spend and logistics to the schedule and the closeout package.
responsibilities: Confirm Material Receiving matches the PO
Track equipment in/out via Go Codes QR scans
Feed cost evidence to the 3-Way Match gate (upstream finance integration)
Account for RFI-driven cost impacts

domains.name: Construction Estimating
domains.summary: Estimating surface. Reads the CSI-division trade skills (d03, d05, d22, d23, d26) to scope and price work; consumes RFI outputs to true up estimates against field reality.
responsibilities: Use CSI-division trade skills as the unit-of-work catalog
Price and quantify trade work prior to award
Update estimates against RFI-driven design changes
Hand off scope baseline to PM domain at mobilization

domains.name: Construction Scheduling
domains.summary: Scheduling surface. The 3-Week Look Ahead is the forward-looking control; the Daily Log is the backward-looking record; Field Monitoring keeps the variance honest.
responsibilities: Author the 3-Week Look Ahead each cycle
Reconcile the 3WLA against the Daily Log
Trigger schedule alerts via the Field Monitoring loop
Provide the schedule input to PM coordination and ops-agent dashboards

domains.name: Construction Closeout
domains.summary: Closeout surface. Punchlist Closeout drives defects to zero; As-Built Updates capture field deviations into the record set so the owner inherits a true archive.
responsibilities: Drive Punchlist Closeout to zero before substantial completion
Capture As-Built Updates back into the drawing set
Hand off final records to the turnover package
Close the governed-work loop opened by the kernel

domains.name: Operational Agents (ops-agents)
domains.summary: The operational-agents tier referenced by the construction-ops-agents skill family: live-action gate, source-query receipt, contract authority. These agents sit alongside the construction domains and enforce or record the governed controls in real time.
responsibilities: construction-live-action-gate — gate state changes against real-world observation
construction-source-query-receipt — log and verify the source authority for every claim
construction-contract-authority — bind controls back to the contract layer in the kernel
Provide receipts to PM/Super dashboards and to the closeout archive
